lesson.grammar_point: polite requests with I would like and Can I have

listenings.text: Good evening, everybody. This is your captain speaking. We are now at ten thousand metres and the sky is clear all the way to London. The cabin crew start the dinner service in about ten minutes. Tonight you have two options: chicken with rice, or beef with potatoes. We also have a vegetarian meal for the passengers who asked for it before the flight. If you have any allergy, please tell the crew before you take the tray, not after. We land at six in the morning, local time. Please try to sleep a little. Thank you.

Hello again, this is Karen from the crew. Just a short message about the second service. In about one hour we come back with breakfast: a small sandwich, fruit and coffee or tea. If you are sleeping, we do not wake you up, and you can ask for your breakfast later. If you need water at any time in the night, please do not wait for us. Come to the back of the plane and take a bottle. It is free, and it is there all night. If you need a blanket for the children, we still have some. Just press the button above your seat. Thank you, and good night.

extra_audio.text: Excuse me. I would like the chicken, please. And can I have some water? One more thing: my son is allergic to nuts. Thank you very much.
